briefings.title: James Gorman - Chairman Emeritus of Morgan Stanley  | Investment Conference 2026

people.name: James Gorman
people.role: Chairman, The Walt Disney Co. and Chairman Emeritus, Morgan Stanley

briefings.tldr: Effective leadership requires a "strategy-first" approach where business success earns the right to build culture, supported by a transition from employee "tenancy" to institutional "landlordship" and transparent, rigorous succession planning.

briefings.title: Offense or Defense? Positioning Portfolios in Today's Market with Howard Marks and Alper Daglioglu

people.name: Alper Daglioglu
people.role: Head of Global Investment Strategies, Morgan Stanley

briefings.tldr: The current market is characterized by extreme optimism following a historic three-year bull run, signaling a critical need for investors to shift from aggressive growth toward defensive positioning and predictable outcomes.
